tabs.html:
Juniper MX80 Universal Routing Platform | High-Performance, Scalable & Space-Saving Router

Compact & Powerful Routing for Enterprises & Service Providers
The Juniper MX80 Universal Routing Platform is a high-performance, compact, and feature-rich router, ideal for enterprise WAN, Data Center Interconnect (DCI), branch aggregation, and campus networking. Designed to operate in space- and power-constrained environments, the MX80 delivers unmatched scalability, agility, and cost efficiency.

With 80 Gbps throughput, four built-in 10GbE ports, two Modular Interface Card (MIC) slots, and an additional MS-MIC slot for dedicated service support, the MX80 ensures flexible network connectivity and seamless expansion as business demands grow.

80-Gbps Switching Capacity – Ultra-fast performance for high-bandwidth networks
4 x 10GbE Ports – High-speed connectivity for enterprise & service provider applications
2 Modular Interface Card (MIC) Slots – Flexible network expansion options
MS-MIC Slot for Dedicated Services – Optimized for advanced network functions
Space & Power Efficient – Compact 2RU design, ideal for constrained environments

Key Features & Benefits

  • Ultra-Fast Performance – 80 Gbps capacity for high-speed data transfer
  • Flexible Connectivity – 4 x 10GbE ports + 2 MIC slots for scalable networking
  • Modular Design for Growth – Pay-as-you-grow expansion to meet evolving demands
  • Space-Efficient 2RU Form Factor – Perfect for power- and space-limited deployments
  • Enterprise & Service Provider Ready – Ideal for WAN, DCI, branch aggregation & campus networks
  • Energy-Efficient Operations – Optimized power consumption for cost-effective performance

Technical Specifications

Performance & Connectivity
Switching Capacity: 80 Gbps
Ports:
  • 4 x 10GbE Ports
  • 2 Modular Interface Card (MIC) Slots
  • Expansion Slot: 1 x MS-MIC Slot for Dedicated Services
  • Form Factor: 2RU Rackmount

Power & Efficiency

Optimized for Low Power Consumption
Compact 2RU Design for Space-Saving Deployment

Ideal Use Cases

  • Enterprise WAN Solutions – Reliable, high-speed data transmission
  • Data Center Interconnect (DCI) – Seamless interconnectivity for data centers
  • Service Provider Networks – Scalable networking for demanding applications
  • Branch Aggregation – Efficient and secure branch networking
  • Campus Networks – High-capacity routing for education and corporate campuses

Why Choose the Juniper MX80 Router?

  • Compact, High-Performance Routing – 80 Gbps throughput
  • Flexible Network Expansion – MIC slots for scalable connectivity
  • Service-Optimized Architecture – MS-MIC slot for dedicated network services
  • Energy & Space-Efficient Design – 2RU form factor for constrained environments
  • Proven Reliability in Demanding Networks – Enterprise-grade performance
